verdict.rationale: MailerSend's first-party webhooks API lets users subscribe to real-time event notifications at a URL they provide. It sends a verification test request when a webhook is created or updated, and it retries non-2xx responses with exponential backoff for about 3 days. Its MCP server can also manage webhooks for agent-driven setup. Missing for 10: an enumerated list of subscribable event types, payload signing/verification details, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Webhooks allow you to subscribe to real-time notifications about various events that occur in MailerSend.
When creating or updating a webhook, MailerSend will send a test request to the provided URL to verify that it is reachable.
If your endpoint is unreachable or returns a non-2xx response, MailerSend automatically retries with exponential backoff for up to about 3 days.
This server enables AI assistants to send emails and SMS, manage domains, templates, webhooks, suppressions, sender identities, users, and many other things through standardized MCP tools.
